sessionHandling.problem: CONVERSATION HISTORY NOT PASSED TO CLARIFICATION PROCESSOR

details.frontend: ChatClarification.tsx sends conversationHistory in request body
details.backend: /goals/:id/clarify endpoint receives conversationHistory but DOES NOT extract or use it

backendReceives.issue: conversationHistory is in req.body but NOT extracted

processorCalled.issue: conversationHistory is NOT passed to processor

rootCause.summary: The clarify endpoint ignores conversation history, causing AI to lose context
rootCause.impact: Follow-up replies fail because AI doesn't know what was discussed before
rootCause.solution: Extract conversationHistory from req.body and pass it to processClarifications
